tiktok.caption:
When you're a freelancer with ADHD and the client is waiting 🫠

9am: today I'm finally sending the proposal. 10:30: I opened the doc, then checked my email instead. 1pm: I reorganized my Notion. Twice. 3pm: I know exactly what to write. I just can't start.

So I told FOCO about it. It broke it into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just opening my last proposal as a template. Three minutes, jazz on. Sent at 4:10.

What task have you been avoiding? 👇
Save this for your next proposal day 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
